cover_headline: Bharat Semi Raises $24 Million Seed Round to Build AI Image Sensors in India

end.headline: Bharat Semi Raises $24 Million Seed Round to Build AI Image Sensors in India
end.line: The New Delhi startup, still pre-revenue, says it has design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon and targets first commercial production in 2027.

facts: $24 million raised in an all-equity seed round led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures
Design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon, with first commercial production targeted for 2027
About 75 employees across India and the United States, including 10 to 12 in Santa Clara

quote.speaker: Vrinda Kapoor
quote.text: Our aim here is to move from sensors to sense-making solutions.
